environments-yml:
- environment: "my-first-env"
  project-dir: "."
  url: "https://github.com"
  format-check-in-root-dir: false
  pr-comment-group: "dev"
  terraform-init-additional-dirs-yml:
    - "./main"
    - "./modules"
  goals-yml: [all, destroy-plan, destroy, apply-on-pr, destroy-plan-on-pr, destroy-on-pr]
- environment: "my-second-env"
  project-dir: "."
  url: "https://github.com"
  pr-comment-group: "dev"
  extra-envs-per-goal-yml:
    plan:
      GOMEMLIMIT: 24GiB
  extra-envs-from-secrets-per-goal-yml:
    apply:
      TF_VAR_my_custom: more
  pr-auto-merge-from-actors-yml:
    - "env-actor"
  pr-auto-merge-limits-yml:
    plan-max-count-add: 5
- environment: "also an env"
  project-dir: "."
  url: "https://github.com"
  goals-yml: [init, format, validate, lint]
extra-envs-from-secrets-yml:
ARM_CLIENT_ID: ARM_CLIENT_ID_secret
ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID: ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID_secret
ARM_TENANT_ID: ARM_TENANT_ID_secret
TF_VAR_my_custom: TF_VAR_my_custom_secret
extra-envs-per-goal-yml:
plan:
  GOMEMLIMIT: 12GiB
  GOGC: 25
apply:
  GOMEMLIMIT: ~
lint:
  GOGC: 400
pr-auto-merge-limits-yml:
plan-max-count-add: 0
plan-max-count-change: 0
plan-max-count-destroy: 0
plan-max-count-import: -1
plan-max-count-move: -1
plan-max-count-remove: 0
